note: Ten top-level domains; sub-categories map to their parent. A risk can sit in several domains (first one is primary).

domains.label: Food safety, food security and agriculture

kinds.hazard: A source of potential harm (e.g. heatwaves, a virus).
kinds.risk: The combination of a hazard with exposure and vulnerability: something that may happen and cause harm.
kinds.ongoing event: Something already happening that institutions are tracking.
kinds.vulnerability: An underlying weakness that makes harm more likely or larger.
kinds.signal: An early warning or weak signal that is not yet an established risk.
kinds.assessment: A published report or statement about any of the above.
